world.description: I, Pencil: a pencil supply chain that keeps running. Loggers cut cedar in Oregon, a mill saws it into slats, graphite is mined in Sri Lanka and mixed with clay into leads, a factory in Pennsylvania glues leads into slats, paints them and adds erasers and brass ferrules, packs them into boxes, and trucks deliver the boxes to shops across the country, which sell them to customers.

world.label: Pencil Supply Chain
world.summary: A recurring supply chain turns cedar, graphite, clay and other materials into pencils that shops sell to customers.

actions.description: Cut cedar and add logs to the logger's stock.
Mine graphite and add it to the miner's stock.
Mix graphite with clay to make pencil leads.
Make boxes and add them to the box maker's stock.
Glue leads into slats, paint the pencils, and add erasers and brass ferrules.
Deliver cedar logs from the logger to the mill worker.
Deliver cedar slats from the mill worker to the pencil maker.
Deliver graphite from the miner to the lead maker.
Deliver pencil leads from the lead maker to the pencil maker.
Deliver boxes from the box maker to the pencil maker.
Truck packed pencils from the factory to a shop.
Sell pencils from the shop to a customer for the shop's listed price per pencil.
